entities.summary: Castile or Castille is a territory of imprecise limits located in Spain. The Encyclopædia Britannica defines it as encompassing Old Castile and New Castile, as they were formally defined in the 1833 territorial division of Spain. Castile is a historical region with roots in Europe. A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
